messages:
natalie.w: hey team — i'm finishing onboarding this week. Can someone grant me staging Console access and feature-flag admin on staging? Need prod read-only (no toggles) for now. GitHub: nataliew. Thanks!
sam: welcome! can you confirm your manager signed off and which specific flags you need admin for? i'll start the staging role once i have that.
infra-bot: Access request created: INC-21234. Assigned to @sam.
natalie.w: tanya approved in my onboarding doc — she said i should get access for onboarding_* flags + onboarding_test. manager: @tanya.
mike: quick security check — make sure SSO + 2FA are active and you've accepted the AUP. cannot grant prod-read until AUP is signed. ping me once done.
tanya: confirmed — onboarding_* and onboarding_test are fine. i'll add you to the feature-admins group in staging. happy to walk through the Console and flag conventions at 2pm today if that helps.
sam: done — staging Console role = admin, added to group feature-admins (staging). INC-21234 updated. Try https://console.staging.redwood.ai and report any permission errors.
natalie.w: i can log in and toggle onboarding_test in staging, looks good. i signed the AUP and uploaded it to the portal (link in onboarding doc).
mike: received AUP, verified 2FA — assigning prod-read now (no toggle). Note: prod admin toggles require two approvals and an RFC. :thumbsup:
sam: prod-read granted. If you need access to any other flag groups, open a new request and tag @tanya + @mike. welcome aboard!
